# word-api

> Lightweight, high-performance Go + Upstash Redis REST API for prefix word autocomplete, semantic related-word recommendations (built from Stanford GloVe embeddings), and hashtag generation.

- Production Base URL: `https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com`
- Content-Type: `application/json` (all data endpoints), `text/plain; charset=utf-8` (`/llms.txt`)
- Input constraints: Lowercase ASCII letters `^[a-z]{1,30}$` (leading `#` and whitespace are stripped automatically; uppercase input is lowercased).
- Rate limit: Fixed-window per client IP (`RATE_LIMIT`, default `60` requests/minute/IP). Exceeding the limit returns `429 Too Many Requests` with `{"detail": "rate limit"}`.
- Caching: In-memory TTL cache (10 minutes, up to 20,000 entries per instance); automatically cleared on `POST /learn`.

## Endpoints

### GET /suggest
Prefix autocomplete ranked by word frequency in Redis sorted sets (`ac:<prefix>`).

- Query Parameters:
  - `q` (required): Prefix string (`1-30` ASCII letters, e.g., `trav`).
  - `n` (optional): Number of suggestions to return (`1-20`, default `8`).
- Example Request:
  `GET https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com/suggest?q=trav&n=8`
- Example Response (`200 OK`):
  `["travel", "traveling", "travelers", "travels", "travelling", "travis", "traverse", "travellers"]`

### GET /related
Returns up to 8 precomputed semantically similar words using cosine similarity over Stanford GloVe word vectors (`rel` hash).

- Query Parameters:
  - `w` (required): Target word (`1-30` ASCII letters, e.g., `travel`).
- Example Request:
  `GET https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com/related?w=travel`
- Example Response (`200 OK`):
  `["travelers", "trips", "traveling", "trip", "travelling", "destinations", "travellers", "flights"]`

### GET /hashtags
Combines prefix autocomplete (`GET /suggest`, up to 8 items) and semantic related words (`GET /related`) into a deduplicated list of up to 10 `#`-prefixed hashtags.

- Query Parameters:
  - `q` (required): Prefix or word (`1-30` ASCII letters, `#` optional, e.g., `trav`).
- Example Request:
  `GET https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com/hashtags?q=trav`
- Example Response (`200 OK`):
  `["#travel", "#traveling", "#travelers", "#travels", "#travelling", "#travis", "#traverse", "#travellers"]`

### POST /learn
Increments frequency scores by `1` across Redis sorted sets (`ac:<prefix>`) for all prefixes of `word` from length `1` up to `10`, then clears the in-memory suggestion cache.

- Headers:
  - `X-API-Key` (required): Must match the server's `WRITE_KEY` environment variable.
- Query Parameters:
  - `word` (required): Word to boost (`1-30` ASCII letters, e.g., `travel`).
- Example Request:
  `POST https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com/learn?word=travel` with header `X-API-Key: <WRITE_KEY>`
- Example Response (`200 OK`):
  `{"ok": true}`
- Error Responses:
  - `401 Unauthorized`: `{"detail": "unauthorized"}`
  - `400 Bad Request`: `{"detail": "invalid input"}`
  - `502 Bad Gateway`: `{"detail": "redis error"}`

### GET /health
Liveness check used by Render health probes and keep-alive monitors. Does not query Redis.

- Example Request:
  `GET https://word-suggestion-yaub.onrender.com/health`
- Example Response (`200 OK`):
  `{"ok": true}`

### GET /llms.txt
Returns this machine-readable API specification in Markdown (`text/plain; charset=utf-8`).

## Repository & Architecture

- `main.go`: Go HTTP server, middleware (CORS, IP rate limiting, 2s request timeout), in-memory cache, Redis client, and 12-minute Render keep-alive goroutine.
- `scripts/build.py`: Builds `data/words.json` (27,562 words) and `data/related.json` (top-8 cosine neighbors) from plain-text or binary Word2Vec GloVe embeddings.
- `scripts/loader.py`: Seeds Upstash Redis with `ac:<prefix>` sorted sets and the `rel` hash table.
- `Dockerfile`: Multi-stage build (`golang:1.23` -> `gcr.io/distroless/static`).
